title: Support Operations Cost and Performance Analysis Report
executive_summary: This report analyzes 347 support tickets to evaluate cost, speed, reopening rates, and agent concentration. The total labor cost was $27,422.90. Key findings indicate that email tickets have a significantly higher reopening rate than chat (119.8% higher), and the Beta team incurred the highest labor costs. A segment of 12 high-cost, low-satisfaction tickets was identified for review.

key_findings.statement: The dataset contains 347 tickets with a mean resolution time of 75.2 minutes and a total labor cost of $27,422.90.
Team Beta had the highest total labor cost at $10,247.36, followed by Gamma ($9,387.73) and Alpha ($7,787.81).
Resolution times varied by channel: chat was slowest at 83.0 minutes, email averaged 73.0 minutes, and phone was fastest at 69.3 minutes.
The email reopening rate was 17.2% compared to 7.8% for chat, representing a 119.8% increase relative to the chat baseline.
There were 12 tickets identified as high-cost and low-satisfaction, with a reopening rate of 8.3%.
Resolution times had a median of 65.0 minutes and a standard deviation of 51.9 minutes. The average satisfaction score was 4.15, with 19 tickets missing a score.
The team consists of 18 unique agents. The most active agent handled 26 tickets, accounting for 7.5% of the total volume.

limitations: Satisfaction scores were missing for 19 tickets (5.5% of the dataset), which may bias the satisfaction mean.
The analysis assumes the 'cleaned.csv' input accurately represents the operational period; data collection errors in the source system are not accounted for.
Labor cost calculations depend on the accuracy of the cost attribution logic applied during the cleaning stage.
conclusion: The analysis highlights a significant disparity in reopening rates between email and chat channels, suggesting process improvements are needed for email ticket handling. While agent concentration is relatively low, the identification of 12 high-cost, low-satisfaction tickets provides a specific target for quality review to improve efficiency and customer experience.
